FAQS

Questions about Saudi employment visa support

Does Shukriya guarantee visa approval?

No. Visa issuance decisions are made only by the competent authorities. We assist with preparation, documentation and formalities relevant to the process.

Can you help with Wakala or employer coordination?

Yes. We can guide clients and employers on the relevant documentation and formal coordination associated with the process.

Are requirements the same for every case?

No. Requirements can vary by employer, job category, nationality and current regulatory instructions. Always confirm the current checklist before final submission.
